findings.title: SQL injection in invoice filter
findings.description: User-supplied `sort` reaches the query builder unescaped in src/invoice/list.ts; also reachable through the export endpoint.
findings.evidence:
src/invoice/list.ts:41
  const order = req.query.sort;
  db.raw(`SELECT * FROM invoices ORDER BY ${order}`)
src/export/csv.ts:12 forwards req.query.sort unchanged

findings.title: Verbose error page in staging
findings.description: Stack traces returned on 500 in the staging environment.
